theorems.name: Submission.doraggt_graph_map_gram_identity
theorems.statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ) (ι : Euclid n →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (ι' : Euclid k →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (T : Euclid n →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid k), (∀ v w, inner ℝ (ι v) (ι' w) = 0) → LinearMap.adjoint (ι.toLinearMap + ι'.toLinearMap ∘ₗ T) ∘ₗ (ι.toLinearMap + ι'.toLinearMap ∘ₗ T) = LinearMap.id + LinearMap.adjoint T ∘ₗ T
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
